PLBIO 512: Advanced study of plant resource acquisition and utilization considering molecular, physiological, and whole plant perspectives through lectures and problem solving.
PLBIO 513: Advanced study of plant communication, growth, and development considering molecular, physiological, and whole plant perspectives through lectures and problem solving.

PLBIO 516: An intensive introduction to contemporary molecular biology methods as applied to the study of plants.
